events.speaker: maren_holt
lines: So you're who the council sent. One truck, one chainsaw that hates everybody, and Theo.
Try not to break any of them. Especially Theo. Paperwork's a nightmare.

events.speaker: theo_vance
lines: Big one. Want me to cone it off while you get the saw going?
Or are we doing cowboy rules today? I'm fine either way. Mostly.

events.speaker: theo_vance
lines: That's a service line tangled in the branches. It's still spitting.
Nobody touches that trunk until the utility kills it. Truck radio's in the cab.

events.speaker: maren_holt
lines: Scene's not coned. A kid on a bike just went under that trunk to watch you.
Cones first. Always. I won't say it twice.

events.speaker: rosa_mendes
lines: Rosa, on the station phone: "Tomás made his recital. He told everyone a fire captain moved a whole tree."
"I said you weren't a captain. He said you looked like one. Don't let it go to your head."

events.speaker: maren_holt
lines: The rest of that oak came down on the Mendes roof. Nobody hurt. Rosa's furious, and she's not wrong.
We can't un-drop a tree. We can patch a roof, if the budget stretches. Check the board.

events.speaker: arthur_penhallow
lines: Arthur Penhallow insisted on playing the crew a thank-you on his trombone. From the end of his drive. At volume.
Theo says it was 'Abide With Me'. Maren says it was a war crime. Either way, he waved until you were out of sight.

events.speaker: theo_vance
lines: Mr Penhallow's roof took the canopy. He keeps saying it's fine. It's not fine. There's a tree in his bathroom.

events.speaker: maren_holt
lines: Clean scene. Cones out before the saw. That's how my old guv'nor did it.
Maybe you'll do.

events.speaker: theo_vance
lines: Someone left a tin of pão de queijo on the bay door. Note says: 'For the crew who didn't make my grandson miss his recital. — R.M.'
I've eaten four. For quality control.

events.speaker: theo_vance
lines: Drove past Alder Lane. Blue tarp on the Mendes roof. Tomás waved at the truck anyway.
Priya reckons we could patch it properly if we found the money.

events.speaker: rosa_mendes
lines: "You didn't have to do that." Rosa hands Maren a coffee she didn't ask for.
"Next storm, I'm calling you first. Before my sister."

events.speaker: priya_nair
lines: Had a look at the rings on those logs we stacked. Rot line, sure. But there's a clean drill hole going right into it.
Trees don't drill themselves. Somebody wanted that one down.

events.speaker: rosa_mendes
lines: "It's coming in through that tarp as well as the drains. The ceiling's dripping into the cellar."
She doesn't say it was your tree. She doesn't have to.

events.speaker: tomas_mendes
lines: Tomás is at the cellar door in wellies, holding a torch like it's a lightsaber.
"Nan says I can help if I stay on the steps. I'll hold the light. You moved the whole tree, so this is easy for you."

events.speaker: rosa_mendes
lines: "Boiler's fine. Fuse box is fine. Tomás has decided he's joining the fire service."
"I've told him he needs to finish Year Five first."

events.speaker: maren_holt
lines: Mendes boiler's gone. They'll be cold for a week while the insurance argues.
That family's had a rough month, and some of it's on us. Remember that next time the call comes in.
